achievements.name: Zombie Slaughter
achievements.description: Killed 500 zombies. Not a bad start.

achievements.name: Zombie Destruction
achievements.description: Killed 5,000 zombies. Is that all you've got?

achievements.name: Z-Genocider 2: Genocide Harder
achievements.description: Killed 53,596 zombies. You left them all for dead!

achievements.name: Zombie Genocide Master
achievements.description: Killed 72,000 zombies. King of carnage!

achievements.name: Vigilante Justice
achievements.description: Defeated 5 psychopaths. There's a new sheriff in town!

achievements.name: Judge, Jury and Executioner
achievements.description: Defeated 10 psychopaths. The world is a safer place.

achievements.name: Zombie Fu
achievements.description: Killed 1,000 zombies barehanded. Those were some killer moves!

achievements.name: Wrong Kind of "Chopper"
achievements.description: Killed 1,000 zombies while riding a motorcycle. Chainsaws on the side make it easier.

achievements.name: He Hasn't Covered Wars...
achievements.description: Used every type of firearm on a zombie. Bang!

achievements.name: Head Trauma
achievements.description: Used every type of melee weapon on a zombie. Anything is deadly in the right hands.

achievements.name: Death From Afar
achievements.description: Used every type of ranged weapon on a zombie. They can't bite you if they're already dead.

achievements.name: Explosive Temper
achievements.description: Used every type of explosive on a zombie. Kaboom!

achievements.name: Slaughter - S = Laughter!
achievements.description: Used every type of novelty weapon on a zombie. Lighten up a bit!

achievements.name: Come on! Follow Me!
achievements.description: Escorted 8 survivors at once. It's a party, everyone is invited!

achievements.name: Saving the Day
achievements.description: Saved 10 survivors. But more are still out there...

achievements.name: Hero of Fortune City
achievements.description: Saved 50 survivors. What a great guy!

achievements.name: Needs More Chainsaw
achievements.description: Created a combo weapon. Introduce it to the nearest zombie!

achievements.name: Duct Tape FTW
achievements.description: Created all combo weapons. Now put them to use!

achievements.name: Apprentice Rising
achievements.description: Reached level 25. Halfway there!

achievements.name: Professional Rising
achievements.description: Reached level 50. You're a machine!

achievements.name: Fashion Aficionado
achievements.description: Changed into 10 different pieces of clothing. Looking dapper, chap!

achievements.name: Chuck Greene: Cross-Dresser?
achievements.description: Changed into all the clothes in the game. Zombie invasion is no excuse for poor style.

achievements.name: Clean Record
achievements.description: Completed The Facts. The End... or is it?

achievements.name: Bartender
achievements.description: Mixed a drink. Tasty stuff!

achievements.name: Look at All That Juice!
achievements.description: Created and consumed all mixed drinks in the game. Just like Mom used to make.

achievements.name: Finally Full
achievements.description: Ate all types of food in the game. That can't be healthy.

achievements.name: Having a Gas
achievements.description: Killed 1,000 gas zombies. As if zombies weren't bad enough...

achievements.name: Father of the Month
achievements.description: Gave Katey a gift. It's good to spoil her sometimes.

achievements.name: Father of the Year
achievements.description: Gave Katey every possible gift. Bribery is the fastest way to earn a child's love!

achievements.name: Justice Served
achievements.description: Completed Overtime Mode. TK got what he deserved.

achievements.name: Better With a Friend
achievements.description: Solved all case files in Co-op. You're a great friend!

achievements.name: Don't You Die on Me!
achievements.description: Revived another player in Co-op. He owes you one.

achievements.name: Big Spender
achievements.description: Spent $6,000,000 total in Fortune City. Where did you get all that money?

achievements.name: Window Shopper
achievements.description: Entered all the stores in the game. Did you buy anything?

achievements.name: Masquerade
achievements.description: Had 10 zombies with masks on at once. You showed them who's boss!

achievements.name: Improper Behavior
achievements.description: Spray-painted all Zombrex posters. They didn't do much good in the first place.

achievements.name: TK's Favorite
achievements.description: Played and won in all 9 TIR events. A true American hero!

achievements.name: Rising Star
achievements.description: Came in first place in a single TIR event. Victory tastes sweet!

achievements.name: Win Big!
achievements.description: Finished in first place in a TIR episode. Don and Paul love watching you go!

achievements.name: Custom Finish
achievements.description: Gave your bike a custom paint job. Sweet ride!

achievements.name: Curiously Inventive
achievements.description: Collected all combo cards hidden in Fortune City. Inspiration is all around you.

achievements.name: Life Saver
achievements.description: Collected all combo cards from survivors. The gift of zombie killing!

achievements.name: Tough Guy
achievements.description: Collected all combo cards from psychopaths. Pried from their cold, dead fingers.

achievements.name: Half Deck
achievements.description: Collected 25 combo cards. So many combinations, so little time.

achievements.name: Full Deck
achievements.description: Collected all combo cards. All 49. Seems odd, doesn't it?

achievements.name: Data Miner
achievements.description: Filled all entries in the notebook and made some friends along the way.

achievements.name: Smashy
achievements.description: Smashed 100 zombies using the Smash skill move. Brains everywhere!

achievements.name: Stick 'em up
achievements.description: Covered a zombie in objects. That sure was funny!

achievements.name: The Skill to Survive
achievements.description: Tamed Snowflake. Keep some steak handy, just in case.

achievements.name: Tape It or DIE!
achievements.description: Created the secret combo weapon, the Wingman - combine Nectar (mix two Orange Juices, or Orange Juice and Beer) with a Queen (dropped by certain zombies, available after giving Katey Zombrex on Day 2) in a Maintenance Room.
